content: Both ligands inactive again; atom 0 on ligand 1 is the thiophene methyl over an acyclic bond. Third linker variant this generation. I have tried replacing the anilide carbonyl with a sulfonyl and reversing the amide; this one keeps the amide exactly as it is and inserts a second nitrogen, turning it into a urea. That holds the conjugated aryl-N-H I know is required and adds an N-H on the cap side. I tested a third linkage once before and it did not pay - but that was a third aryl-N(H)-azine, which duplicated the motif and cost 0.16 of QED. A urea N-H to an aliphatic cap is a much cheaper addition, about 15 Da and one donor, and it was present in some of the molecules that first showed activity in run 1, so it has never been cleanly isolated on a good scaffold. Surviving methyl becomes the pyridine 4-methyl, meta anilide and everything else unchanged. Expected product: about 296 Da with three donors.
